ItemHelp.SteamDetails_1Hz: Push the Steam server details at most once per interval instead of every frame; tag updates queued by the game go out at once
ItemHelp.PlayerBans_1Hz: Walk the temporary-ban list once per interval (vanilla walks it every frame: BanUpdateDelay -= Time.unscaledTime bug); ban checks at connect untouched
ItemHelp.Fog_SkipPresentation: Skip FogOfWar.ShowFog (+ its UpdateVisibilityAll sweep) and FogOfWar.UpdateFogPixelBlend; explore pass, pixel data and GetPositionVisible keep running [headless only]
ItemHelp.Fog_DetectedTargetLookup: FogOfWar.OnUpdate: DetectedTargets.IndexOf -> Team.DetectedTargetIndexes lookup (same result, O(1))
ItemHelp.Animators_Disable: Disable soldier/creature Animator components after init and keep them off (activation distance, dead-pose repair, after death); skip parameter writes while off [headless only]
ItemHelp.Particles_Disable: Turn off play-on-awake and stop/clear particle systems on projectiles, units, structures and the loaded scene [startup-only] [headless only]
ItemHelp.SceneLOD_Skip: Skip and disable SceneLOD.SceneLODCell (camera-distance scenery renderer toggling) [headless only]
ItemHelp.LightGrid_Skip: Skip LightGrid.Update (light toggling grid; no server reader) [headless only]
ItemHelp.VehicleEngineVents_Skip: Skip VehicleEngineVents.OrderedUpdate (vent wobble near the camera); destroyed vehicles still run vanilla [headless only]
ItemHelp.VehicleCreaking_Skip: Skip VehicleCreaking.OrderedFixedUpdate (creak sounds on movement changes) [headless only]
ItemHelp.ConstructionWarningUI_Skip: Skip ConstructionWarningUI.UpdateUI (warning-sign animation); ConstructionSite.UpdateEffects is NOT touched [headless only]
ItemHelp.CreatureAttackFX_Skip: Skip OnAttackStart of CreatureAttackFX / GlowBlob / GlowCurves / GlowEye / GlowTongue (per-attack light + FX registration) [headless only]
ItemHelp.CreatureAttackInflate_Skip: Skip CreatureAttackInflate.OnAttackStart (inflate/deflate transform animation). Moves transforms: check hit zones before enabling [headless only] [default off]
ItemHelp.Diag_LogExceptions: Hook Application.logMessageReceived: count exceptions (and Animator warnings), log the first distinct ones of each round with a short stack

ItemHelp.Census: Read-only: 1 Hz rigidbody census per unit kind (awake/asleep/kinematic/interpolated) + 2-step wake window (woke in simulate+frames vs in fixed scripts) + fixed steps per frame; log line every CensusLogSeconds
ItemHelp.WakeProbe: Diagnostic: IsSleeping() of the unit body before/after the soldier, creature, wheeled/hover vehicle, anti-flip and avoidance fixed/frame updates; logs woke/slept counts per method every CensusLogSeconds [default off]
ItemHelp.RestWriteGuards: Skip same-value writes of detectCollisions/useGravity/position (Soldier fixed updates) and linearVelocity/useGravity (CreatureDecapod.OrderedFixedUpdate) so resting bodies are not re-woken; values identical to vanilla [default off]
ItemHelp.HitZonePoseGuard: Skip the per-frame re-pose of HumanModel / SwarmBugModel (carry the kinematic hit-zone body) when the pose is bitwise unchanged; hit-zone capsules, aim points and self-hit exclusion unchanged [default off]
ItemHelp.IdleForceSleep: End-of-step Sleep() for idle AI wheeled vehicles (game's SleepVehicle) and ground creatures after IdleSleepSeconds at rest; woken by the game's own input/contact/force paths [default off]
ItemHelp.AvoidanceIdlePairSkip: CollisionAvoidance: no avoidance impulses / turn writes between two idle AI vehicles (both directions); off-navmesh return push and any pair with a moving or player unit unchanged [default off]
ItemHelp.CatchUpCap: Time.maximumDeltaTime = MaxCatchUpSteps x fixedDeltaTime (default 2 -> at most 2 fixed steps per frame; game: 0.1 s = up to 3)
ItemHelp.FixedStep_Override: Time.fixedDeltaTime = 1 / FixedStepHz (default 20 Hz; game 25 Hz). Changes everything that counts fixed steps, see TimeStep.cs [default off]
ItemHelp.Interpolation_Off: No Rigidbody interpolation on the headless server (Unit/Vehicle.EnableRigidBodyInterpolation forced off, Soldier.OnExitCompartment reset to None) [headless only] [default off]

ItemHelp.CommanderAI_SkipOwnedTeams: Skip AICommander.Tick for a team only while a mod declares (Settings.CommanderOwnerProbes) that it needs nothing from that team's vanilla commander; no probe = vanilla
ItemHelp.CommanderAI_ThinkStats: Measurement only: wall time of every AICommander.Think (outermost patch, includes other mods' Think patches); count / avg / max per round in the status
ItemHelp.Astar_CutPollInterval: AstarPath.navmeshUpdates.updateInterval raised to Settings.NavmeshCutUpdateInterval (vanilla 0 = cut dirty-poll every frame); removals, dirty tiles and ForceUpdate stay immediate
ItemHelp.Astar_ProbeFlushDebounce: CollisionObstacleManager.ApplyChanges(null) from VehicleBlockerProbe at most once per Settings.ProbeFlushMinIntervalSeconds (pending blockers kept, deferred call from OnUpdate); stuck-recovery calls never delayed [default off]
ItemHelp.Detected_IndexLookups: DetectedTargets.IndexOf/Contains -> Team.DetectedTargetIndexes in Team.LostTarget, Target.GetDetectedByTeam, Team.GetTargetDetected, AITask_Attack.Think (same result, O(1))
ItemHelp.DestroyedDisposal_EveryN: BaseGameObject.UpdateDestroyedDisposal (walk over all objects to age wrecks) every Settings.DestroyedDisposalEveryNFrames frames with the accumulated dt; wrecks vanish at most N-1 frames later
ItemHelp.TerrainMaterial_Cache: GamePhysics.GetTerrainPhysicMaterial(Vector3, Terrain) with TerrainPhysicsMaterials, transform, terrain size and alphamap size cached per Terrain (same result); no TerrainPhysicsMaterials = vanilla
ItemHelp.Net_SkipUpdatesNoClients: Skip NetworkComponent.TickNetworkObjects (per-object update serialization) while no remote player is in Player.Players; joins still get the full NetInit

ItemHelp.Tier_Structures: Update list: Structure/HumanStructure/AlienStructure/ConstructionSite.OrderedUpdate every 4 frames while quiet (no production queue, no navmesh requeue, no relink pending); accumulated dt
ItemHelp.Tier_HealDecay: Update list: AutoHeal/Decay.OrderedUpdate every 4 frames (dt-scaled 5 s ticks); full rate on player-controlled/occupied units
ItemHelp.Tier_OrderProcessors: Update list: AIOrderProcessor.OrderedUpdate every 4 frames while its order queue is empty (body is idempotent then)
ItemHelp.Tier_IdleSoldiers: Update list: Soldier.OrderedUpdate every 4 frames for idle AI soldiers (no target/path/order/damage/aim-at, not moving, no view input)
ItemHelp.Tier_StaticNetTransforms: Fixed list: NetworkTransformComponent.OrderedFixedUpdate of objects without Rigidbody every 5 steps while no change is pending
ItemHelp.Tier_IdleAgents: Prefix AIBaseAgent.OrderedUpdate (inside OrderedUpdateAllAgents): idle AI soldier/ground-vehicle/alien agents every 4 frames with accumulated dt; full rate on any target/path/order/damage/aim-at/nearby detection [default off]
ItemHelp.Register_O1: S11: UpdateList.Register/Unregister via a delegate dictionary + binary search (identical order and dup/removal semantics); every 64th call cross-checked against the vanilla scan
ItemHelp.FixedLate_StepDt: Fixed-late list once per physics step (run at the next step's FixedUpdate, dt = fixedDeltaTime) instead of once per frame with the folded dt [default off]

ItemHelp.DetectedGrid: Per-team grid over Team.DetectedTargets (rebuilt per frame and physics step, additions tracked via Team.DetectTarget); needed by the *_Grid items, off = they run vanilla
ItemHelp.CollectEnemies_Grid: TargetFinder.CollectDetectedEnemies visits only DetectedGrid cells within the scan range (same candidates, same order)
ItemHelp.UrgentClose_Grid: AIAiming.FindUrgentCloseEnemy visits only DetectedGrid cells within 15 + r + 30 m (same first hit in list order)
ItemHelp.NearestTarget_Grid: Team.FindNearestTarget visits only DetectedGrid cells within range (same nearest, same tie-break)
ItemHelp.AlarmProximity_Grid: AlarmProximity.OrderedFixedUpdate: 'offensive enemy within ProximityDistance' from DetectedGrid cells (same flag; rest of the method verbatim)
ItemHelp.FriendlyFire_Grid: Target.CheckRiskOfFriendlyFire visits only fine-grid cells within maxDist instead of the whole 1 km TargetGrid cell (same answer; snapshot = TargetGrid's own)
ItemHelp.Rank_Sort: TargetFinder.Rank: stable insertion sort instead of the O(C^2) selection sort (identical order, ties included)
ItemHelp.LosTopK: APPROXIMATE: TargetFinder issues LOS queries only for the top LosTopK candidates (no target when all of them are blocked) [default off]
ItemHelp.FriendlyFire_Cache: APPROXIMATE: reuse a weapon's CheckRiskOfFriendlyFire answer for FriendlyFireCacheSeconds while its muzzle barely moved [default off]
